items.title: Goldman Sachs Expects US Data Centre Expansion to Boost Electricity and Natural Gas Demand Through 2028
items.summary: Goldman Sachs expects rapid growth in US data centre capacity to continue through 2028, increasing demand for electricity and natural gas as artificial intelligence investment drives the development of larger and more energy-intensive facilities. The investment bank estimates that an additional 52 gigawatts (GW) of data centre power capacity could become operational in 2028, potentially placing further pressure on US electricity markets.
